messages:
nina: I opened a tiny PR to tighten up streaming snippets across py/ts/go: explicit cancel hooks, brief retry config, and a short note on the opaque cursor token. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021

raj: Nice. Can we keep each example to a single small block so the MD renderer doesn't wrap badly? Also prefer `cursor` naming consistently.

anya: I'll draft compact versions. Suggest showing AbortController (TS), context timeout (Go), and retry dict (Py).

nina: Drafts below, super compact. Please nit.

nina: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for ch in c.stream('gpt-small', prompt='joke', max_tokens=32, cursor=None, retry={'strategy':'exp','max_attempts':2}):
  print(ch.text)
```

nina: ```ts
const ac=new AbortController();setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),1200)
for await(const p of client.stream('gpt-small',{prompt:'joke',maxTokens:32,cursor:null,signal:ac.signal,retry:{strategy:'exp',maxAttempts:2}}))console.log(p.text)
```

nina: ```go
ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),1500*time.Millisecond)
defer cancel()
iter:=client.Stream(ctx,"gpt-small",redwood.StreamOpts{Prompt:"joke",MaxTokens:32,Cursor:""})
for iter.Next(){fmt.Println(iter.Current().Text)}
```

ci-bot: lint: use `max_tokens` in Python; fixed Go import if needed.

raj: tiny nits: 1) note under each snippet: "cursor is opaque; store and pass back as-is"; 2) use `cursor:null` in TS (already done).

anya: I'll add the one-line note and a GH action `examples-smoke` that runs these 3 snippets behind an env guard.

sam: :thumbsup: Once smoke CI passes I'll merge.
